title: .openlanes.yml
description: A project's openlanes settings. Precedence, loudest first: a flag typed on the command line, the plan's spec.md frontmatter, this file, the built-in default.

project.description: Heading for INDEX.md; null takes the root's name

frontend.description: A spec's `frontend:` when spec.md omits it; null lets each plan decide

jobs.description: How many plans `openlanes run` works on at once

adapter.description: The coding agent for every agent that names none; null is claude

redis_url.description: The Redis the live run shares: a redis://, rediss:// or unix:// URL

redis_outage_hours.description: How long agents stay paused for a lost Redis before the run shuts down; null is 1

ci_pending_hours.description: How long CI may stay pending after verification before the plan is surfaced to a person; null is 4

redis_backoff.description: How a lost Redis is asked again

initial.description: Seconds; the Fibonacci gaps are its multiples

cap.description: Seconds, the longest gap between two asks

jitter.description: Full jitter: each gap drawn from [0, gap)

desired_codebase_quality.description: What a review that is ok but not perfect does (R4); null until the person is asked

merge.description: Who merges a reviewed pull request, and when it stops going back

by.description: Who merges a reviewed PR (M4); null is human

max_rejections.description: Rejections before the plan stops going back to its builders (M6); null takes the quality's

commands.description: Per-command option defaults, by command name: run, "resync dirs"

agents describe.description: Open one specialist's definition in a Markdown viewer

mdfried.description: Render in the terminal through mdfried instead of the system viewer

agents list.description: List every specialist, what it handles, and what it advances to, then which coding CLIs can take an agent on this machine

api docs.description: List the openapi.yaml files in the plan folders, and check each one parses

config move.description: Move the legacy config file to .openlanes/config.yml, with git mv so its history follows

dry_run.description: Show the move without making it

coverage.description: Run a plan's declared test command in its worktree and check line coverage

dry_run.description: Print the declaration and where the command would run; run nothing

create.description: Create the next numbered plan folder

after.description: Create a retroactive plan in the gap after this plan, e.g. 002

depth.description: How hard every phase should think: fast, medium or deep. Written into spec.md's frontmatter

draft.description: For a new feature (no --prs), attempt spec.md's four headings from project context via `claude`. --no-draft leaves them bare

from.description: Seed from a markdown file: its frontmatter `title:` names the folder, and its body fills the spec.

open.description: Open the new spec.md in the system editor when done (macOS `open`). --no-open leaves it for you to open

prs.description: Document work that already shipped: pull request numbers or URLs, comma separated. Requires --after

spec.description: With --prs, write spec.md from what the pull requests did. --no-spec records them and stops, which is fast and offline

starts.description: Where the plan starts: research (the whole spine), planning (skip research), building (one agent, a short mechanical task). Written into spec.md as starts:

status.description: Open in a state other than the default

describe.description: Open one specialist's definition in a Markdown viewer

mdfried.description: Render in the terminal through mdfried instead of the system viewer

docs.description: Generate the conventions document from the state machine itself

output.description: Write here instead of STDOUT; - for STDOUT

engine.description: The factory's engine over the whole tree, until Stop All Local; `openlanes start` runs it

admin_credentials.description: USER:PASSWORD, the Basic auth login asked of every request from off this machine; required when listening past loopback (default: $OPENLANES_ADMIN_CREDENTIALS)

agent.description: Only run this one agent; answered blocked.md questions are still drained

all_interfaces.description: Listen on every interface, the same as --ips 0.0.0.0

git_push.description: With --isolation worktree, a finished branch is pushed and its pull request opened as soon as it lands, titled [NNN.MM](X). --no-git-push turns that off and leaves it uncommitted.

ignore_bombs.description: Work on while a 💣 stands: a plan others wait on, blocked too long, halts nothing this run

ips.description: Comma-separated addresses the control room listens on, e.g. 127.0.0.1,192.168.1.20 (default: 127.0.0.1). Any address past loopback needs --admin-credentials

isolation.description: worktree: a checkout and branch per plan, run in parallel. shared: one tree, serial

jobs.description: Agents to run at once (default: cores - 2, capped at 12)

log.description: Write the log to FILE, appending; - for STDOUT (default: log/development.log under the project root)

log_format.description: color or standard (one line per entry, with or without colour) or json (default: standard)

max_tokens.description: Token budget per agent invocation, input plus output, sub-agents included. The agent is told the number so it can finish inside it; the meter aborts it past the number so the telling is true. (default: unmetered)

memory.description: Tell each agent the lessons in .openlanes/memory/lessons meant for it; --no-memory leaves them out, the baseline that shows whether they help

model.description: Model for every agent this run, overriding each agent's own frontmatter and spec.md (default: what the agent declares, else the CLI's default). Claude models above Opus run as Opus

open.description: Open the control room in the browser; --no-open only prints its URL

plan.description: Only these plans, comma separated: NNN or NNN.MM, e.g. --plan 003,005.01. Default: the whole tree

port.description: Port the control room listens on

prompt.description: Extra instructions appended to the agent's prompt (only with --agent); a path to an existing text file under 80 characters is read instead

redis_url.description: Redis for the live board, its commands and plan claims shared with other machines (default: .openlanes/config.yml redis_url, else $REDIS_URL, else redis://localhost:6379/0)

rescan.description: Seconds between rescans of .plans while idle; a command from the page rescans at once

root.description: Repository root the agents work in (default: the .plans parent)

rounds.description: Cap on rounds per agent per plan; each agent declares its own, at most 5 (default: the agent's own)

skip.description: Never assign this agent; its plans wait, the rest of the pipeline runs. Answered blocked.md questions are still drained, even with --skip unblocker. Comma separated for several

timeout.description: Seconds before one agent is abandoned; only tightens an agent's own clock (default: the agent's own, else 900)

user_config.description: Start agents with your personal plugins, skills, hooks and MCP servers. Off by default: they cost every agent context and start-up time on every turn

web.description: Serve the control room from this process; --no-web leaves it to an `openlanes web` run apart, as `just start` does, and the engine waits for that page

eval.description: Score agents against evals/cases: recorded folders by default, real runs with --live

case.description: Only the case with this id

cases.description: Directory of <agent>/<id>.yml cases (default: the gem's evals/cases)

depth.description: Hold every case to this depth's bounds instead of its own

live.description: Run the real agent in a temp repository (spends tokens)

memory.description: With --live, tell the agent your global lessons; --no-memory is the baseline that shows whether they help

events report.description: Report completion, blocks, time to answer, PR outcomes and usage from the event log

format.description: table for people, json for scripts

output.description: Write the report here instead of STDOUT; - for STDOUT

index.description: Create or update .plans/INDEX.md — a global index of every plan.

output.description: Write somewhere other than <plans>/INDEX.md; - for STDOUT

project.description: Heading for the page, default: the repository's directory name

init.description: Write .openlanes/config.yml at the project root and create the plans directory

ci.description: What checks pull requests: github_actions, circleci, jenkins, gitlab, buildkite, external or none (-y default: what the folder runs)

dry_run.description: Write nothing; print the file that would be written

frontend.description: Whether plans have a front end; leave it out to let each plan decide

jobs.description: How many plans `openlanes run` works on at once (default: cores - 2)

merge_by.description: Who merges a reviewed pull request (default: human)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing .openlanes/config.yml, which is otherwise kept

project.description: Heading for INDEX.md and similar (default: the root's directory name)

quality.description: desired_codebase_quality: high, standard or mvp (R4); asked on a terminal when left out

reconfigure.description: Ask again with the current answers as defaults; show the diff before writing

setup.description: Run openlanes setup first when the machine is not ready; --no-setup skips the check

starts.description: Where new plans start: research, planning or building (default: research)

yes.description: Ask nothing; take the flags and the defaults

linear import.description: Create Linear issues from the plans: one per folder, one child per work unit

dry_run.description: Send nothing to Linear; print what would be created and updated

format.description: json emits the exact arguments the Linear MCP tools take

project.description: The project to file everything under: its URL, its name, or its id

since.description: Skip plans numbered below this, e.g. 010.00

status.description: Only plans in these states: a comma-separated list of status keys

update_unchanged.description: Update everything, whether the plan has changed or not

linear projects.description: List the Linear projects a team owns, and which plans they already cover

mail ack.description: Mark a message in a plan's mailbox as read

for.description: The agent that read it, who must be its recipient

mail read.description: Print the messages waiting for an agent in a plan's mailbox

after.description: Only messages numbered above this, so a poll shows what is new

mail render.description: Print a plan's whole mailbox as Markdown

mail send.description: Append a message to a plan's mailbox

memory approve.description: Mark a waiting lesson for promotion whatever the number of plans it was seen in

memory curate.description: Have the curator read finished or rejected plans and propose lessons into .openlanes/memory/inbox

agent.description: Hand the plans to a different agent

dry_run.description: Invoke no agent; name the plans that would be read

memory inbox.description: List the lessons waiting in .openlanes/memory/inbox, and the plans each was seen in

agent.description: Print the section this agent's prompt would carry, e.g. --agent backend-coder

memory promote.description: Turn waiting lessons into active ones: those seen in 2 plans, or approved, as a memory pull request a person merges

dry_run.description: Write nothing; print what would be promoted, confirmed or left waiting

local.description: Write the lesson files into this checkout and open no pull request

memory scan.description: Check that nothing under .openlanes/ is a secret or is ignored by git. Exits 1 when something is

plans.description: Print every plan, its state, and its pull requests

all.description: Also list the plans in archive/, deferred/, abandoned/, discarded/ and trashed/

plans abandon.description: Take plans out of the active list, because work on them stopped

dry_run.description: Move nothing; print what would move and be rewritten

reason.description: The reason, for every plan listed; asks each plan's otherwise

plans discard.description: Take plans out of the active list, by deliberate decision

dry_run.description: Move nothing; print what would move and be rewritten

reason.description: The reason, for every plan listed; asks each plan's otherwise

plans trash.description: Remove plans from the workspace: done elsewhere, never to be done, or to start over

dry_run.description: Move nothing; print what would move and be rewritten

reason.description: The reason, for every plan listed; asks each plan's otherwise
